answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, we utilize decentralized trust-flow routing where reputation flows like a river from verified anchor nodes. An attacker attempting to spoof identities must deposit collateral that accumulates like a rising dune of capital. If an agent's trust metric falls to its nadir, it is pruned from the network, making the marginal cost of maintaining fake nodes exponentially higher than the utility of the attacks they can execute.
